Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Straight A.overview: Lachlan Giles' armbar anthology, eight volumes (about 11.5 hours). Volume 1 is the overview. Volume 2 is a long section on breaking grips. Volume 3 covers armbars from mount (mount to S-mount, opening the elbow). Volume 4 covers side control (the far-side armbar). Volume 5 covers half butterfly. Volume 6 covers the shoulder crunch position. Volume 7 covers the closed guard head-and-arm. Volume 8 covers the choi bar from top.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - Straight A.for: No-gi grapplers who want a complete armbar game.
key: Armbars from half butterfly and the shoulder crunch

Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - The Bodylo.overview: Lachlan Giles' body lock passing system in six volumes (about 7 hours): getting the body lock against different guards (butterfly, seated, half guard, knee shield), controlling the hips, stepping over or around the legs, finishing to side control or mount, and dealing with the common counters (leg pummelling, underhooks, rolls into leg entanglements). The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown.
Lachlan Giles/Lachlan Giles - The Bodylo.for: No-gi passers; a pass that works for any body type.
